 Jackrabbit Football team faces another tough opponent after huge win over USD 
 SDSU plays at Northern Iowa Saturday 
 By Mark Ovenden Published : Nov. 4, 2026 at 11:34 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BROOKINGS, S.D. (Dakota News Now) -Speaking of the Jackrabbits, the football team is coming off that huge win over USD Saturday where they dominated the Coyotes for 3 quarters and then hung on at the end for a 31-21 win.
 And now they will head to a very tough place to play in Northern Iowa. The Panthers have always seemed to cause problems for the Jacks so Dan Jackson and his team will be ready. But it will be a much different atmosphere.
 Dan Jackson, SDSU FB Coach says, “I was really excited about the fans that were here last weekend. I thought the noise impacted the game and was a glimpse into what it could be like every Saturday here. I thought it was a positive day for us Saturday, it gives us some things to clean up on and really excited about this weekend’s match-up against a really good opponent and a very tough place to play.”
 The Jackrabbits made life miserable for more than a half last Saturday and if the defense continues to bring that pressure they will be extremely tough to beat down the stretch in the regular season and playoffs in F-C-S football.
